newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petronas, PNOC start talks on oil venture.
newsitem.headline: Petronas, PNOC start talks on oil venture.

text.p: Petronas Carigali Bhd, the oil exploration arm of state-owned Petroliam Nasional Berhad (Petronas) of Malaysia, has identified four areas for possible joint oil and gas exploration with the Philippine National Oil Co, a PNOC official said on Wednesday.

PNOC-Exploration Corp president Rufino Bomasang told Reuters that in a meeting last week with top Petronas officials the areas identified were offshore Vietnam, Algeria, offshore China and portions of the Caspian Sea.
"We will send a team to conduct a due diligence study on these areas within the month," Bomasang said.
He added that PNOC-EC is considering taking up a 15 to 20 percent stake in oil exploration ventures with Petronas.
